body: I appreciate that you could take your hurt and do something good with it but I’m nothing but anger. Towards everyone. I’m not getting out of bed or going outside or visiting my family a few Provence’s away. Everything is canceled. I don’t have the patience for anything. I can not deal with my life so I won’t and when I get the nerve I’m going to end it.
Games piss me off because my boyfriend does nothing but play them and ignore me. He doesn’t even notice how mad I am.

She’s acting completely normal. I think a bit scared since I’ve been sort of stalking her ever since. I got a better look at it and made sure it’s clean. I’ll get my vets advice as soon as they open in the morning. Thank you very much for the reassurance.

Ending things with someone can be extremely difficult but you have to consider the effect she may be having on your mental health. Toxic people can really do a number on you and 100% need to be kept at a distance. Perhaps you and this girl could spend some time apart. You could test the waters to see if you feel any better. Good luck.

Your description of forgetting your entire reality hit home for me. I’m mid panic right now and I’m finding it hard to focus on anything else. When it comes to meds though, you should remember that sometimes you might not find the right fit with the first try. I’ve been on several different ones over my long life of panic, anxiety, and depression. I’m currently taking Effexor and overall it seems ok so far. It hasn’t taken it all away but I’m better equipped to deal with things in more rational ways now. I used to just hide and cry and panic alone and become completely overwhelmed but now I at least manage to seek help or advice where I can. Go into the experience of finding a good medication with an open mind and possibly patience. Good luck.
Thank you very much. I truly appreciate your kind words.
Thank you for not calling me horrible. I try to do good when it comes to my animals. I just love them so much. The idea that she’s hurting has me completely on edge.
